historical_reference.label: More than 48,000 active peer-reviewed scholarly journals, all languages
historical_reference.source_title: STM Global Brief 2021: Economics & Market Size
historical_reference.note: Historical benchmark, not a 2026 census. Do not extrapolate or use as an RSS denominator.

scope: Purposive overview of 12 representative publishers/platforms; neither exhaustive nor a ranking. Portfolio, hosted-directory, archived and forthcoming title definitions differ. No cross-publisher grand total is calculated.

publishers.name: Elsevier
publishers.count_scope: Publisher portfolio; not a title-by-title active-journal census.
publishers.rss_evidence: ScienceDirect documents RSS for all journal issue and book series alerts, not search RSS. Policy scope is the platform; no complete title census.
publishers.beginner_zh: 综合学科；含 Cell Press、The Lancet 等品牌

publishers.name: Springer Nature
publishers.count_scope: Group portfolio, 2025 OA report. Nature and BMC are not added again.
publishers.rss_evidence: Nature journal homepage explicitly links an RSS feed. This is journal-level evidence, not a group-wide policy.
publishers.beginner_zh: 综合学科；Nature、Springer、BMC 不重复统计

publishers.name: Taylor & Francis
publishers.count_scope: Company-published portfolio. The separate platform claim of 2,700+ is not interchangeable.
publishers.rss_evidence: Official 2019 user guide describes RSS alerts. Historical support evidence, not proof of present coverage.
publishers.beginner_zh: 综合学科；Routledge、Dovepress、PeerJ 属集团品牌

publishers.name: Wiley Online Library
publishers.count_scope: Platform collection count; not deduplicated current publisher-owned active journals.
publishers.rss_evidence: Official researcher guide describes TOC and Early View RSS via Journal Tools. Complete current coverage not enumerated.
publishers.beginner_zh: 综合学科；本次数字为平台馆藏口径

publishers.name: Sage
publishers.count_scope: Press office states 1,100 journals; older journal landing text also says 1,440 portfolio / 1,100+ browse. Conflict retained; no reconciled precise count.
publishers.rss_evidence: Official Sage RSS help states Recent Articles and OnlineFirst feeds are available for all hosted titles. Platform policy, not a live title census.
publishers.beginner_zh: 人文社科及理工医；官网数字存在口径差异

publishers.name: Oxford University Press
publishers.count_scope: Author-facing page reports more than 500 journals; collections and archives overlap and are not added.
publishers.rss_evidence: Official guide provides RSS types and instructs readers to check whether a title participates.
publishers.beginner_zh: 综合学科与学会合作出版

publishers.name: Cambridge University Press
publishers.count_scope: Researcher page reports over 400 peer-reviewed journals.
publishers.rss_evidence: Official help says feeds are available from journal listings, home, issue and article pages.

publishers.name: MDPI
publishers.count_scope: Official US about page: 536 peer-reviewed + 9 conference journals. Directory may include forthcoming journals; not an active-only count.
publishers.rss_evidence: Official journal directory displays RSS download links; no complete live link census performed.
publishers.beginner_zh: 开放获取；须区分同行评审期刊与会议刊

publishers.name: Frontiers
publishers.count_scope: Live journal directory includes society/partner journals. Do not compare directly with a 2022 RSS list.
publishers.rss_evidence: Official 2022-06-30 article contains 125 distinct RSS-labelled links. 124 paths end in /rss; one Electronics link points to a journal homepage. Listed candidate paths, not live verified feeds.

publishers.name: IEEE
publishers.count_scope: Official IEEE publication topic page states more than 200 journals and transactions. Does not count all partner content in IEEE Xplore.
publishers.rss_evidence: Official Xplore personal-account help documents RSS alerts for saved search results and updated tables of contents.
publishers.beginner_zh: 电子、电气、工程与计算机

publishers.name: American Chemical Society (ACS)
publishers.count_scope: Official 2026 metrics article says over 90 journals. RSS table has 91 titles, with 2 feed options each.
publishers.rss_evidence: Rendered official RSS table enumerates 91 unique journal titles, each with ASAP and TOC options (182 options, not 182 journals).

publishers.name: Association for Computing Machinery (ACM)
publishers.count_scope: Official March 2024 press release reports more than 70 journals; historical, not a 2026 exact count.
publishers.rss_evidence: No current publisher-wide official RSS policy established in this review. Absence of evidence is not evidence of no RSS.
publishers.beginner_zh: 计算机领域；规模证据发布于 2024 年
